purpose: Source-isolated OpenCompass 0.5.1 vs 0.5.2 Track A1 dependency-lock contract. This is a public reconstruction contract, not the DeMix authors' environment.

python.execution_requirement: Do not execute Track A1 until a resolver-generated lock contains exact version and artifact hash for every installed distribution.

install_surface.rule: Compile one shared environment from the union needed by OpenCompass [full], not runtime-only. Use the 0.5.2 full dependency surface as the superset and retain the stricter 0.5.1-compatible pandas constraint.
why: OpenCompass 0.5.2 unit-test workflow installs .[full], not runtime-only.
setup.py defines full as requirements/runtime.txt plus requirements/extra.txt.
0.5.2 eagerly imports newly added dataset families from opencompass.datasets; several dependencies are declared only in requirements/extra.txt.
A runtime-only environment can therefore create a false 0.5.1/0.5.2 import difference caused by missing optional dataset dependencies rather than OpenCompass source semantics.

critical_dependency_boundary.full_install_correction: pyext is still present in requirements/extra.txt at both anchors, so pyext is not actually removed from the [full] environment. Under Track A1/full, the direct pyext runtime diff is neutralized; pandas remains the important direct version constraint difference.
observed_import_detail: biodata.py imports numpy, pandas, torch, scipy.stats and sklearn.metrics at module import time.

CMPhysBench SEED imports sympy and timeout_decorator at module import time; sympy is not explicitly listed in OpenCompass runtime/extra and must therefore be captured explicitly by the resolved transitive lock rather than left implicit.

shared_constraints.note: These are reconstruction pins already selected in the role-local Track A planning line. They are not claims about the DeMix author environment. All remaining direct/transitive packages, including torch/sympy/scipy/pyext and the full extra union, must be resolver-pinned and hashed before execution.

lock_generation_contract.input: OpenCompass 0.5.2 requirements/runtime.txt + requirements/extra.txt, plus the shared constraints above and any stricter requirement needed to satisfy both anchors.
lock_generation_contract.resolver: Use one deterministic Python-3.10 resolver invocation for both anchors; persist resolver version, index URLs, selected wheel/sdist filenames and SHA-256 hashes.
fail_closed: No Track A1 import if any installed distribution lacks an artifact hash.
No source comparison if the two anchors are not executed in byte-identical dependency environments.
Do not silently drop full/extra dependencies to make one anchor import.
Record import-time missing dependency as environment-contract evidence, not as an OpenCompass source regression, until the full shared lock has been satisfied.

blocker: Current local execution environment has Python 3.13 and no network/DNS access; Python 3.10 and unresolved package artifacts cannot be downloaded here. This is an execution-environment limitation, not evidence about OpenCompass behavior.
next_action: In the next environment with package-index access, resolve and hash the full shared Python-3.10 lock from this contract, then execute Track A1 import phase under both OpenCompass source anchors before any score comparison.
